custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active parts, part A and part B, and one inactive part, part C.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all three.
  • Use a computer that can open the exported file in a spreadsheet program.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425588-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425588-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
  • Export is in the Inventory list's three-dot actions menu (with Cycle count and Deactivate parts); it downloads a file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export.

Step 3:

  • A file downloads.

Step 4:

  • The file holds exactly two parts, part A and part B, the parts the search lists on the Active tab.
  • Part C is not in the file.

Step 5:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 6:

  • Part C is listed.

Step 7:

  • The menu lists Cycle count, Activate parts and Export.

Step 8:

  • A second file downloads.

Step 9:

  • The second file holds exactly one part, part C.
  • Parts A and B are not in it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S1-R9: “Export in the actions menu exports the parts on the tab that shows: active parts from the Active tab, inactive parts from the Inactive tab.”
  • S1-R9b: “The export includes every part on that tab that matches the current search, filters and Supply filter, including parts not yet scrolled into view. With nothing matching, the message "Empty export" shows and no file is made.”
